lines.text: Matis! I need help!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Birdie! What seems to be the problem?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: No, it doesn't matter!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: I shall help no matter what the issue!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: You weakling.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: How weak can you be, crawling to us on your hands and knees for assistance?

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Asking for help is nothing to be ashamed of.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: That's true.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: We should help each other when times are tough.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: So what is it?

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: It's unlike you to come to us asking for help.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: I hope you haven't gotten yourself into trouble from lying too much.
I don't know how to lie.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Hehe.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Cutey.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Word gets around, you know.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: We know what you've been doing to the other Nikkes.
That's all just a misunderstanding.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Oh, I'm sure.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: But we're very busy.
Please, I beg you.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Well, if the situation is that serious, then I guess we have no choice but to help.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: What do you need?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Whatever it is, you can count on me!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: That is what Matis is for.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Although we can't help with any criminal activities.
I'm going to the surface with Syuen.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Oh my... I don't even want to know how things got to this point.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: And where do we come into the picture?
I need an escort.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: An escort?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Who do we need to escort?

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: You idiot! Scroll up and read!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Oh!
There is no response from Laplace for a while.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: We're escorting "Cutey"?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Who's that?

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: It's an adorable person.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: How wonderful!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Escorting an adorable person? Count me in.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: I, Laplace the Hero, shall shoulder the burden of escorting this majestic Cutey to their intended destination!
Ugh, my head...

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: I've got some aspirin. Do you want some?

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: All right, I think I understand what's going on here.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: To be honest, Syuen came to us first asking for an escort, hehe.
What?

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: She wanted us to go up with you both.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: You two are likely to make quite a motley crew, hehe.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: So, we'll keep our distance and offer backup from afar when needed.
You tricked me.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Cutey.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: I'll see you up on the surface.
